Step-by-Step Preble County Jail Release Guide

Follow our simple 4-step process to secure immediate release from the Preble County Sheriff & Jail in Preble, OH.

1

Call 24/7 Bail Bonds Immediately

Call 1-866-322-2245 as soon as an arrest occurs. Provide the defendant's full name, date of birth, and booking information at Preble County Jail.

2

Fast Phone Approval & Rate Verification

We review bond amounts set by Preble Municipal Court, Perrysburg Municipal Court, or Common Pleas Court, verify payment options, and finalize easy paperwork over the phone or online.

3

Immediate Bond Posting at 1960 E Gypsy Lane Rd

Our licensed bail agent delivers and executes the bond directly at the Preble County Sheriff's Office booking desk in Preble, OH.

4

Jail Discharge & Court Appearance Guidance

The defendant is released from custody. We provide clear court date reminders and instructions for upcoming hearings at Preble Municipal Court, Perrysburg Municipal Court, or Common Pleas Court.
